verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships an official MCP server that lets users ask natural-language questions ("was my last postgres sync successful", "are any of my connections broken") and perform read/write/delete operations via NL through an LLM client, plus AI coding-agent plugins (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) that let users build/test/deploy connectors using natural-language prompts. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that the MCP server and NL agent plugins work reliably in practice beyond vendor docs, and broader NL coverage of the full dashboard/admin surface.
